answer: In an agent economy, each identity must lock a refundable bond before it can trade, while a random, stake weighted committee checks its signed work against hidden challenge tasks. If identities coordinate to submit copied answers or inconsistent histories, the protocol slashes their bonds and excludes them. A Sybil attacker must therefore finance every fake and keep it active through repeated audits; one exposed cluster can erase the attacker’s capital as it tries to wander across the canyon toward influence on the horizon.
